evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that the model performs well for roleplay and that applying SimPO tuning to it produced particularly strong results.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: roleplay-tuned merge of two 9B text models with no reported factuality or grounding evaluation -> ungrounded roleplay output may be fabricated

possible_risks.description: Manipulative prompts that use social engineering techniques, such as role-playing or hypothetical scenarios, to persuade the model into generating harmful content.
possible_risks.justification: model is explicitly merged for roleplay and Gemmasutra-9B-v1 is included, so social-engineering/roleplay prompts are a core use case -> manipulative roleplay prompts may elicit harmful content

specifications.model_size: 18.9 GiB of safetensors weights (20,318,474,496 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This model is a merge of pre-trained language models created using mergekit, combined with the SLERP merge method. The merge includes princeton-nlp/gemma-2-9b-it-SimPO and TheDrummer/Gemmasutra-9B-v1.
